payload.title: Sankranti Special: Wholesome Nutrimix Ladoos – A Festive Treat for Monsoon Wellness
payload.content:
Sankranti Special: Wholesome Nutrimix Ladoos – A Festive Treat for Monsoon Wellness

As the monsoon season arrives, and Sankranti celebrations are around the corner, it's the perfect time to indulge in traditional treats that not only tantalize our taste buds but also boost our immunity and energy. One such delightful and wholesome dessert is the Nutrimix Ladoo, made with the goodness of sprouted ragi, sprouted jowar, sprouted green gram, roasted almonds, cashews, and the subtle flavor of cardamom.

This recipe is specially designed to incorporate the nutrient-rich Nutrimix, blending the best of traditional Indian wisdom with modern convenience. Each ingredient is carefully selected to provide a mix of complex carbohydrates, proteins, and healthy fats, ensuring that these ladoos are not only delicious but also packed with nutritional value.

Prep Time, Cook Time, Servings

Prep Time: 20 minutes
Cook Time: 10 minutes
Servings: 12-15 ladoos

Nutrition Table

NutrientValue (per serving)
Calories120
Protein2g
Carbs20g
Fats4g
Fiber2g

Ingredients

  • 1 cup Nutrimix
  • 1/2 cup roasted almonds
  • 1/2 cup cashews
  • 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder
  • 1 tablespoon ghee or coconut oil
  • Honey or jaggery syrup for binding (optional)

Instructions

  1. In a large mixing bowl, combine the Nutrimix, roasted almonds, cashews, and cardamom powder.
  2. Heat the ghee or coconut oil in a small pan over low heat.
  3. Pour the warm ghee or oil over the dry mixture and stir well until all the ingredients are nicely combined.
  4. If the mixture is too dry, add a little honey or jaggery syrup to help bind the ingredients together.
  5. Use your hands to shape the mixture into small ladoos.
  6. Place the ladoos on a plate or tray and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set.

Chef Tips

For an extra crunchy texture, you can add some chopped nuts or seeds to the Nutrimix mixture before shaping the ladoos. Also, if you find the mixture too sticky, refrigerate it for about 10 minutes before shaping to make it easier to handle.

Storage Instructions

Store the Nutrimix Ladoos in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. You can also freeze them for up to 2 months and thaw as needed.

Variations

To make vegan Nutrimix Ladoos, replace the ghee with coconut oil and ensure that the Nutrimix and other ingredients are free from animal products. For a gluten-free version, verify that all the ingredients, including the Nutrimix, are gluten-free.

FAQs

  1. Q: Can I customize the Nutrimix Ladoo recipe with other nuts or seeds?
    A: Yes, feel free to experiment with different combinations of nuts and seeds to find your favorite flavor and texture.
  2. Q: Are Nutrimix Ladoos suitable for children and pregnant women?
    A: Yes, these ladoos are made with wholesome ingredients and are a great snack option for children and pregnant women, providing essential nutrients and energy.
  3. Q: How can I ensure the Nutrimix Ladoos are fresh for a longer period?
    A: Always store them in an airtight container in the refrigerator and freeze if you plan to keep them for more than 5 days.
